name: defile-migration-counts
title: Défilé de l'Écluse migration counts

resources.name: count

fields.name: count_id
fields.description: Readable row identifier: era letter (B notebook, S spreadsheet, N NaturaList, T Trektellen), local date YYYYMMDD, local clock HHMM when known, species code, and direction. It is rebuilt at each release and can change after corrections; do not use it as a permanent identifier.

fields.name: survey_id
fields.description: The survey (`survey.csv`) during which the birds were counted.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: When the birds were counted, in UTC (ISO 8601): a time (`2023-09-15T08:12:00Z`), an interval (`start/end`), or a local date (`2023-09-15`) when only the day is known. An entry without a time of its own carries the interval of its survey.

fields.name: taxon_id
fields.description: The taxon (`taxonomy.csv`).

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of birds. Empty only when `count_estimation` is `presence` (birds seen but not counted).

fields.name: count_estimation
fields.description: How the observer qualified the number. Empty: no qualifier was recorded (which does not prove the number is exact).

minimum.description: At least this many birds; the true number was higher.

presence.description: Birds were present but not counted; `count` is empty.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Which way the birds were moving. Use `main` for migration totals; `reverse` and `local` birds are counted separately and must not be added to them.

main.description: Migrating in the main direction of autumn migration.

fields.name: age
fields.description: Age class given by the observer; empty when not recorded. Calendar years start on 1 January. Historical 'immature' and '> 1 an' are both `after_first_calendar_year`.

adult.note: General field usage: an individual judged to show adult plumage; age thresholds are species-specific and this is not a precise calendar-year class. EURING notes that age coding is based on plumage evidence, not known years of life.
adult.euringNote: EURING 2 is full-grown with age otherwise unknown, which is broader than Trektellen Adult. EURING A means after fourth year and is not equivalent.

first_calendar_year.note: Calendar-year age changes on 1 January and does not itself identify plumage; do not automatically convert to juvenile plumage.
first_calendar_year.euringNote: Both indicate first calendar year, but EURING 3 additionally specifies a full-grown bird; the EURING numeric code differs.

second_calendar_year.note: Calendar-year age changes on 1 January and does not itself identify plumage.
second_calendar_year.euringNote: Both indicate second calendar year; the EURING numeric code differs.

third_calendar_year.source: Trektellen interface screenshot; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
third_calendar_year.note: Trektellen display confirms 3cy; verified by maintainer. This is a Trektellen code, not EURING age code 3. Calendar-year age changes on 1 January and does not itself identify plumage.
third_calendar_year.euringNote: Trektellen 3cy matches EURING third-year concept; the EURING numeric code differs.

fourth_calendar_year.source: Trektellen interface screenshot; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
fourth_calendar_year.note: Trektellen display confirms 4cy; verified by maintainer. This is a Trektellen code, not EURING age code 4. Calendar-year age changes on 1 January and does not itself identify plumage.
fourth_calendar_year.euringNote: Trektellen 4cy matches EURING fourth-year concept; the EURING numeric code differs.

after_first_calendar_year.note: English UI shows >1cy (imm); French UI shows >1 an for the same observations. Historical immature and > 1 an descriptors both map to I; original wording is retained in remarks. The combined code alone does not establish adult or non-adult status.
after_first_calendar_year.euringNote: Both indicate older than first calendar year with no exact year. Trektellen labels differ by language; the combined code does not establish maturity and is not a plumage code.

juvenile.source: Trektellen interface screenshot; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
juvenile.note: General ornithological usage defines juvenile plumage as the first true-feather plumage after down, commonly the plumage in which a young bird leaves the nest. Exact appearance and duration vary by species. This Trektellen age label is distinct from EURING Plumage Code J.
juvenile.euringNote: Trektellen label Juvenile is confirmed. EURING has Plumage Code J for juvenile, but that is a different field; do not convert automatically to EURING age 3.

subadult.note: General ornithological literature uses subadult inconsistently for different age/plumage classes; treat this as an observer label without a universal year threshold.
subadult.euringNote: Subadult has no dedicated EURING age code; do not infer a calendar-year age.

not_juvenile.description: Not juvenile (Trektellen label; exact rule not documented)
not_juvenile.note: Literal/general meaning is not juvenile, but the label does not specify whether this is based on plumage or calendar age. A bird can leave juvenile plumage while still in its first calendar year. Trektellen's precise rule is undocumented; do not infer age >1cy.
not_juvenile.euringNote: Native display label is confirmed, but its precise definition is unresolved; no direct EURING age code assigned.

not_adult.description: Not adult (Trektellen label; exact rule not documented)
not_adult.source: Trektellen interface screenshot; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
not_adult.note: In general ornithological usage this is a broad complement of adult and may include juvenile and later immature stages; exact usage varies. Trektellen's precise inclusion rule is undocumented. Raw `non_adult` is normalized to `Non-adult` in released data.
not_adult.euringNote: Display label confirmed; exact age-class criteria remain unresolved, so no direct EURING age code is assigned.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Sex given by the observer; empty when not recorded. `female_type` means female-looking, which includes young males of many species.

female_type.description: Female-looking; the bird may be a female or a young male
female_type.note: FC does not establish that the bird is female.

fields.name: plumage
fields.description: Plumage or colour morph given by the observer; empty when not recorded.

winter.source: Trektellen interface; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
winter.note: Verified Trektellen meaning; retained as the native code.

immature.source: Trektellen interface; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
immature.note: Plumage class, distinct from age I (>1cy, immature); do not force the two fields to agree.

breeding.source: Trektellen interface; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
breeding.note: Verified Trektellen meaning; retained as the native code.

eclipse.source: Trektellen interface; confirmed by dataset maintainer on 2026-10-12
eclipse.note: Verified Trektellen meaning; eclipse plumage applies to ducks.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: Observer's comment on the entry, as recorded (wording already turned into age, sex or time columns is removed).

fields.name: remark_processing
fields.description: Note added during processing, for example when a time was changed or removed. Not written by the observer.

fields.name: trektellen_data_id
fields.description: Identifier of the entry on trektellen.org (2022 onward), for tracing it to the source.

resources.description: One row per taxon, direction and survey entry: the number of birds counted. A row can hold many birds; historical entries described by age or sex are split into one row per class.

x-validationRules.description: A number is required unless count_estimation is presence.
A presence row has no number.
A valid ISO date, UTC time or increasing UTC interval.
`remark` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.
`remark_processing` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.

resources.name: survey

fields.name: survey_id
fields.description: Readable survey identifier: era letter (B notebook, S spreadsheet, N NaturaList, T Trektellen, C curated), local date YYYYMMDD and local start HHMM when known. Rebuilt at each release; it can change after corrections.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: Start and end of the survey in UTC, as an ISO 8601 interval (`start/end`). For a whole-day weather stop with no recorded hours, the interval is the local calendar day; it is not counting time.

fields.name: recording_era
fields.description: How the counts were recorded: `notebook` (1966-2013, daily totals), `spreadsheet` (2014-2016, mostly hourly), `naturalist` (2017-2021, NaturaList entries), `trektellen` (2022 onward, trektellen.org), or `curated` (a weather stop added from the reports, outside the recorded surveys).

fields.name: survey_complete
fields.description: `true`: every bird that passed during this survey is in `count.csv`. `false`: birds are known to have passed uncounted (records lost, birds missed); `survey_comment` says why. It describes this interval only, not the whole day.

fields.name: weather_stop
fields.description: `true`: the weather (rain, fog, storm) made counting impossible during the whole interval. No bird is assumed to have passed; no count is linked to it. Exclude these intervals from counting hours. `false` otherwise.

fields.name: survey_comment
fields.description: Why a survey is incomplete or a weather stop, or what was assumed when the interval was rebuilt. Written during processing; observers' own words are in `remark` and `weather`.

fields.name: observers
fields.description: The people present, comma-separated: names or initials as recorded, with reviewed spelling variants merged. Attendance hours, groups and unreadable fragments are left out.

fields.name: weather
fields.description: Weather as described by the observers.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Temperature in °C. Trektellen's form writes 0 when the field is left unanswered, so a Trektellen 0 is left empty.

fields.name: wind_speed_bft
fields.description: Wind speed on the Beaufort scale, 0 (calm) to 12. Empty: not recorded.

fields.name: wind_direction
fields.description: Direction the wind blows from (16-point compass), or `variable`.

fields.name: cloud_cover
fields.description: Cloud cover in eighths (oktas): 0 clear sky, 8 overcast. Empty: not recorded.

fields.name: cloud_height
fields.description: Cloud height as entered on Trektellen; the unit is not confirmed. Trektellen's form writes 0 when the field is left unanswered, so a 0 is left empty.

fields.name: precipitation
fields.description: Rain or fog as recorded. Empty means not recorded; only `none` says there was none.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: Visibility in metres. Trektellen's form writes 0 when the field is left unanswered, so a Trektellen 0 is left empty.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: Observers' comments on the survey.

fields.name: remark_processing
fields.description: Note added during processing. Not written by the observers.

fields.name: trektellen_count_id
fields.description: Identifier of the survey on trektellen.org (2022 onward), for tracing it to the source.

resources.description: One row per survey: a period when someone was counting, or was on site but could not count because of the weather. Times when nobody was counting have no row; a date without a survey says nothing about the birds (it is not a zero).

x-validationRules.description: Survey timing is an increasing ISO datetime interval with UTC on both endpoints.
A weather stop is a complete count with no bird.
A weather stop says why in survey_comment.
An incomplete survey says why in survey_comment.
`survey_comment` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.
`observers` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.
`weather` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.
`remark` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.
`remark_processing` is one line of text: no line break, tab or other control character, no leading or trailing space.

resources.name: taxonomy

fields.name: taxon_id
fields.description: Avibase identifier of the taxon; `count.csv` links to it.

fields.name: scientific_name
fields.description: Scientific name (AviList; eBird/Clements when AviList has none).

fields.name: english_name
fields.description: English name (AviList; eBird/Clements when AviList has none).

fields.name: taxon_rank
fields.description: Rank: `species`, `subspecies`, or a group of uncertain identification (`spuh`: genus or family only; `slash`: one of two species; `hybrid`; `domestic`).

fields.name: parent_taxon_id
fields.description: `taxon_id` of the smallest group that contains this taxon (the species of a subspecies, or a 'sp.' or slash group); empty at the top. Adding a group's descendants gives every bird counted under it.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Order.

fields.name: family
fields.description: Family.

fields.name: systematic_count_start_year
fields.description: First year this taxon was counted systematically. From that year, a complete survey with no row for it can be read as zero birds; before it, a missing row means unknown. Empty: no start year set.

fields.name: taxonomy_source
fields.description: Checklist and version that gave the scientific name.

fields.name: ebird_code
fields.description: eBird species code, when there is one.

fields.name: trektellen_species_id
fields.description: Trektellen species identifier(s), comma-separated; empty for taxa only in the historical records.

resources.description: One row per taxon counted: a species, a subspecies, or a group used when the bird could not be identified to species (for example 'buzzard sp.').

resources.name: report_text
resources.description: Accepted French report prose indexed by year, category and key, read from raw/reports/report_text.csv. Species keys are dataset Avibase IDs, including broader taxon concepts. Shared passages are not independent evidence; missing rows do not imply absence. Extraction history is archived and is not part of the build.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Report year.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Account category. Together with year and key, identifies one populated account.

species.description: Taxon accounts; key is an Avibase ID in taxonomy.csv, including species, spuh, slash and hybrid concepts.

site.description: Site history, geography and organisational background. Allowed key: background.

monitoring.description: Monitoring protocol, actual effort/coverage and nocturnal monitoring. Allowed keys: methods, effort, nocturnal.

weather.description: Weather and visibility narrative. Allowed keys: season, july, august, september, october, november, december.

results.description: Seasonal results and interpretation. Allowed keys: overview, highlights, discussion.

outreach.description: Public engagement, school activities and visitor communication. Allowed key: activities.

fields.name: key
fields.description: For category species, an Avibase taxon_id from taxonomy.csv. Otherwise a key allowed for the category, as documented below. Weather uses season or an English month name. The year is the report year, including when prose compares earlier years.

methods.description: Field protocol followed by data processing and analysis, with internal headings.

effort.description: Actual dates/hours, staffing, volunteer availability, coverage gaps and observation-point changes.

nocturnal.description: Acoustic/nocturnal monitoring methods, effort, results and limitations; separate from daytime visual counts.

overview.description: Broad seasonal totals, composition and migration patterns.

highlights.description: Notable events, mixed-species observations, irruptions and records.

discussion.description: Interpretation, longer-term trends, limitations and outlook.

activities.description: School activities, public events, visitor attendance and outreach restrictions.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Non-empty curated French report prose, preserving paragraph breaks.

x-validationRules.description: Species accounts must use Avibase taxon IDs.
Allowed keys for site: background.
Allowed keys for monitoring: methods, effort, nocturnal.
Allowed keys for weather: season, july, august, september, october, november, december.
Allowed keys for results: overview, highlights, discussion.
Allowed keys for outreach: activities.
Every species account key must exist in taxonomy.taxon_id.

resources.name: paper_text
resources.description: Accepted French species accounts from all four Nos Oiseaux papers, read from raw/reports/paper_text.csv. Same category/key/text structure as report_text; source_id distinguishes the two 1996 parts and multi-year syntheses. Species keys follow existing Avibase mappings; three group keys retain shared accounts. Missing accounts do not imply absence. Extraction evidence is archived.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Paper identity (the local reference library lists the documents): 1996 Parts I and II describe 1993; 2019 covers 1993–2017; 2020 covers 1993–2019.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Account category; currently species accounts only.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Accepted Avibase taxon concept or shared group key. Group keys cover freux/choucas, three swallow species, and pomarin/criard eagles. Paper taxa can be absent from the count taxonomy; historical names and mapping notes remain in the extraction archive.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Curated French prose with paragraph breaks, including published status and summary statistics where present. Figures and tables omitted; published discrepancies retained.

publication_status: local-reviewed-build; planned CC-BY-4.0 for first-party structured data; rights clearance for curated source text and rights-holder confirmation pending
x-licenseScope: CC-BY-4.0 is the intended licence for first-party structured observation data, taxonomy mappings, metadata and documentation in the public research release and for the Event/Occurrence export to GBIF. It does not license report_text.csv or paper_text.csv, which contain curated excerpts from third-party reports and papers and remain subject to their source rights unless permission is obtained. This licence statement is a release plan pending confirmation that the relevant data rights-holders authorize publication under CC-BY-4.0.
temporal_semantics: Clock instants and interval endpoints are UTC (canonical Z). Date-only counts retain the collection calendar date in Europe/Paris. For daily aggregation, convert instants to Europe/Paris before selecting the date.
description: Bird migration counts, survey intervals and their completeness/weather-stop decisions, taxonomy, and curated annual-report and Nos Oiseaux paper prose at Défilé de l’Écluse.

x-recordingEras.notebook: Historical sheet 1966-2013; digitised daily records; original recording medium not confirmed for every row.
x-recordingEras.spreadsheet: Historical sheet 2014-2016; mainly hourly forms with some daily records.
x-recordingEras.naturalist: Historical sheet 2017-2021; mixed entry and intervals; 2021 is a transition year.
x-recordingEras.trektellen: Native paired exports from 2022; earlier 2021 export is archived, not added twice.
x-recordingEras.curated: Documented weather-stop interval added outside native survey periods. Calendar or bounded times identify the interval; its duration is never observed counting effort.

x-validationNotes: Frictionless validates standard types, constraints, primary keys and foreign keys. x-validationRules declare project rules implemented by the local validator; generic Frictionless validators do not enforce these extensions. Age, sex and plumage are independent recorded attributes: no cross-field combination is prohibited, and one attribute must not be inferred from another. Release build checks additionally reject counts linked to weather stops and overlapping survey intervals; these cross-table/time rules are not enforced by validate_package alone. See docs/survey-coverage.md and docs/audit.md for assumptions and interpretation.

x-surveySemantics.completeness: survey_complete refers to birds accounted for within the recorded interval, not daily or seasonal coverage. Documented incomplete surveys are valid records, not unresolved audit findings.
x-surveySemantics.absence: Known unmonitored intervals are cut out. Missing survey dates remain unknown; do not zero-fill them.
x-surveySemantics.observedHours: Union of complete, non-weather-stop intervals within each Europe/Paris day. A day intersecting any incomplete survey has unknown observed hours. Weather-stop calendar bounds never contribute observed hours.
x-surveySemantics.historicalEmptyIntervals: Within declared historical day windows, omitted empty hours are inferred as complete intervals under the organiser recording convention. Reviewed absences are cut out; no species zeros or observer/weather measurements are invented.
x-surveySemantics.audit: Missing dates and short days within reported season windows are coverage context, not warnings by themselves. Warnings concern unresolved status evidence; release failures concern inconsistent status, missing required explanations, counts linked to weather stops, and overlapping survey intervals.
